# SF.gov

> > Official website of the City and County of San Francisco providing access to municipal services, regulations, and government resources.

SF.gov serves as the primary digital gateway for San Francisco residents, businesses, and visitors to access city departments, apply for permits, understand regulations, and engage with local government. The site covers everything from Civil Service Commission rules and cannabis regulation to youth services, housing policies, and strategic planning documents.

## Key Topics

- Civil Service Commission
- San Francisco Rent Board
- Office of Cannabis
- DCYF (Department of Children, Youth and Their Families)
- Municipal Transportation Agency (MTA)
- Civil service rules and regulations
- Employment rights and equal opportunity
- Cannabis regulation and equity programs
- Youth and family services
- Permit and licensing processes
- Housing and rent control
- Strategic planning and policy
- Public health vital records
- Department of Technology
- Ballot measures and elections

## City Departments and Services

- [Children, Youth and Their Families](https://www.sf.gov/departments--children-youth-and-their-families): DCYF funds youth and family programs across San Francisco
- [DJJ Realignment Subcommittee](https://www.sf.gov/departments--djj-realignment-subcommittee): Juvenile Justice Council subcommittee developing youth realignment plans
- [DCYF Community Needs Assessment (CNA)](https://www.sf.gov/reports--january-2022--dcyf-community-needs-assessment): DCYF 5-year community needs assessment for youth and family services
- [2022 - 2025 Strategic Plan for the Department of Technology](https://www.sf.gov/reports--january-2023--2022-2025-strategic-plan-department-technology): Department of Technology strategic plan for digital transformation

## Civil Service Rules and Regulations

- [Rule 311: Examinations (Civil Service Commission)](https://www.sf.gov/reports--july-2000--rule-311-examinations-civil-service-commission): Civil Service Commission rules for examinations and promotional exams
- [Rule 407: Rules Related to the Employee Relations Ordinance (Civil Service Commission)](https://www.sf.gov/reports--july-2000--rule-407-rules-related-employee-relations-ordinance-civil-service-commission): Civil Service rules on service-critical employees and labor relations
- [Rule 112: Eligible Lists (Civil Service Commission)](https://www.sf.gov/reports--october-2018--rule-112-eligible-lists-civil-service-commission): Civil Service Commission rules for eligible lists and hiring procedures
- [Rule 422: Separations (Civil Service Commission)](https://www.sf.gov/reports--july-2000--rule-422-separations-civil-service-commission): Civil Service rules on employee separations and termination procedures
- [Inspection Service (Civil Service Adviser 25)](https://www.sf.gov/reports--june-2006--inspection-service-civil-service-adviser-25): Civil Service Commission inspection and oversight procedures guidance
- [Policy on Citywide Employee Personnel Records Guidelines (Civil Service Commission)](https://www.sf.gov/reports--may-2007--policy-citywide-employee-personnel-records-guidelines-civil-service-commission): Civil Service Commission guidelines for employee personnel records

## Housing and Rent Regulations

- [Rent Board Rules and Regulations: Part II - Board Organization and Procedures](https://www.sf.gov/reports--december-2022--rent-board-rules-and-regulations-part-ii-board-organization-and-procedures): SF Rent Board governance rules, meetings, and voting procedures
- [Rent Board Rules and Regulations: Part IV - Rent Increases Not Requiring Approval by the Rent Board](https://www.sf.gov/reports--december-2022--rent-board-rules-and-regulations-part-iv-rent-increases-not-requiring): Rent Board rules on allowable rent increases and tenant notice requirements

## Cannabis Regulation and Equity

- [Section 1608(c)(9) Equity Commitment Required for Ownership Transfer - Temporary Regulation](https://www.sf.gov/reports--december-2024--section-1608c9-equity-commitment-required-ownership-transfer-temporary): Office of Cannabis temporary regulation on equity commitment for permits
- [Bulletin 2019-03: Enforcement Principles and Office of Cannabis Identification](https://www.sf.gov/reports--february-2019--bulletin-2019-03-enforcement-principles-and-office-cannabis-identification): Office of Cannabis enforcement principles and inspection procedures

## Elections and Public Documents

- [Qualified measures](https://www.sf.gov/reports--november-2024--qualified-measures): Ballot measures qualified for June 2026 election by Board of Supervisors
- [Energy Performance Report](https://www.sf.gov/reports--march-2019--energy-performance-report): SF Environment building energy performance and emissions benchmarking data
- [More about Death Certificates](https://www.sf.gov/reports--october-2022--more-about-death-certificates): Public Health Office of Vital Records death certificate information

## Optional

- [Language diversity policy](https://www.sf.gov/reports--february-2018--language-diversity-policy): SF workplace policy on language diversity and equal employment access
- [Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) policy in the City and County of San Francisco](https://www.sf.gov/reports--may-2021--equal-employment-opportunity-eeo-policy-city-and-county): City EEO policy covering discrimination and harassment protections
- [Community Meeting Minutes](https://www.sf.gov/reports--april-2023--community-meeting-minutes-0): Sheriff's Department Oversight Board April 2023 community meeting minutes
